text_zh:
Scriptor V-████ · 笔记一
M.1██ 年 ██ 月

今日奉命抄录第六层收容廊的铅字目录。每一枚字钉都需详细记录其版级、重量与铸印痕迹。初铭者 Valis 的教诲言犹在耳："形不可变，誓不可违。"

铅字在灯下泛着冷光。我按部就班逐一记录，墨水渗入羊皮纸的声音令人安心。每一笔都工整，每一字都合规。这便是我辈职责。

一切正常。
text_en:
Scriptor V-████ · Note One
M.1██ Year ██ Month

Today assigned to transcribe the glyph inventory of the sixth containment vault. Each slug requires detailed recording of gradus, weight, and impression marks. The words of First Inscriber Valis still echo: "Form must not change, oaths must not break."

The lead gleams cold under lamplight. I record each methodically, the sound of ink seeping into parchment brings comfort. Every stroke neat, every character compliant. Such is our duty.

All proceeds normally.

text_zh:
Scriptor V-████ · 笔记二
M.1██ 年 ██ 月

第六层的异文收容工作持续进行。今日编目了七十三枚脱版铅字，均已妥善归入标准收容格。每枚字钉的铭刻纹路都清晰可见，无异常变化。

按照§4.2条例，我需在每日收工前填写F-017表单。墨水充足，羊皮纸库存正常。油灯燃料剩余约三刻钟。

值班记录已更新至档案柜第二抽屉。一切工作均按标准程序完成。明日将继续第六层剩余区域的编目任务。
text_en:
Scriptor V-████ · Note Two
M.1██ Year ██ Month

Anomalous glyph containment work continues on the sixth layer. Today catalogued seventy-three Solum slugs, all properly sorted into standard containment grids. Each slug's inscription patterns remain clearly visible, no abnormal changes observed.

Per regulation §4.2, I must complete Form F-017 before end of shift. Ink supply adequate, parchment stock normal. Oil lamp fuel remaining approximately three quarters of an hour.

Duty logs updated to archive cabinet second drawer. All work completed per standard procedure. Tomorrow will continue cataloguing remaining sections of the sixth layer.

text_zh:
Scriptor V-████ · 笔记三
M.1██ 年 ██ 月

今日第六层收容廊编目工作已近尾声。发现三枚逆版异文，已按§7.1条例上报并等待处置指令。铭刻痕迹完整，无泄漏现象。

油灯熄灭前我将完成最后十二枚定版字钉的记录。羊皮纸上墨迹未干，但字迹工整如初。每一笔都遵循初铭者的教导，每一字都承载着我们的誓言。

工作即祷告，祷告即工作。这便是键徒之道。

明日我将按时到岗，继续履行职责。
text_en:
Scriptor V-████ · Note Three
M.1██ Year ██ Month

Today the sixth containment vault cataloguing work nears completion. Discovered three Inversum anomalies, reported per regulation §7.1 and awaiting disposal instructions. Inscription traces intact, no leakage phenomena.

Before the oil lamp dies I will complete records for the final twelve Fixum slugs. Ink still wet on parchment, but script remains as neat as ever. Every stroke follows the First Inscriber's teachings, every character bears our oath.

Work is prayer, prayer is work. This is the keybound way.

Tomorrow I will report punctually and continue fulfilling my duties.

text_zh:
████-████ · 值班记录一
M.1██年，第94日

今日我于第V层排字区接手值班。前任交接顺利，字盘编码一致，铅屑清扫已毕。收容经卷更新：新增三部禁书残章，版级皆为活版。我已按标准程序将其编入当日收容清册。

铅字圣坛运行正常。诵经声清晰可辨。

我将严格按条例执行值班职责。
text_en:
████-████ · Duty Log One
M.1██, Day 94

I have assumed watch at Layer V sorting station today. Handover from predecessor was smooth, type-case codes consistent, lead shavings cleared. Containment codex update: three new forbidden text fragments added, all Mobilum grade. I have entered them into today's containment roster per standard procedure.

Lectern of Keys operates normally. Litany voices clearly audible.

I shall execute watch duties strictly per regulation.

text_zh:
████-████ · 值班记录二
M.1██年，第127日

本职于今晨发现异常现象：第三字盘出现未列册铅字符。经核对，该字符不在任何收容经卷中。本职已将其移至待审区，填写F-017事件报告。

铅字圣坛诵经略有变调。油壶添补正常。

本职建议复查第V层全部字盘。
text_en:
████-████ · Duty Log Two
M.1██, Day 127

This position discovered anomaly this morning: unlisted leaden glyph appeared in third type-case. Upon verification, said glyph exists in no containment codex. This position has moved it to pending review area, filed F-017 incident report.

Lectern of Keys litany slightly off-key. Oil flask refilling normal.

This position recommends full re-inspection of all Layer V type-cases.

text_zh:
████-████ · 值班记录三
M.1██年，第163日

此岗位记录：字盘清洁如期完成。铅屑归坩无异常。收容经卷更新已录入系统。诵经声稳定。油壶液位充足。

第V层排字区运行参数均在标准范围内。无需额外维护。

此岗位将按既定流程继续执行职责。
text_en:
████-████ · Duty Log Three
M.1██, Day 163

This station records: type-case cleaning completed as scheduled. Lead shaving crucible return shows no anomaly. Containment codex updates logged in system. Litany voices stable. Oil flask levels sufficient.

Layer V sorting area operational parameters all within standard range. No additional maintenance required.

This station will continue executing duties per established procedure.

text_zh:
████-████ · 值班记录四
M.1██.█.██

本岗位今日接收新配发铅字盘三套。经标准检视程序，发现第二套字盘铅字排列存在微小偏差。已按条例将偏差字符移除并归入废料坩锅。

本岗位注意到前值守员留下的茶渍仍在桌案左侧。此岗位不饮茶。

第五层排字工作一切正常。此岗位将继续执行分配任务。
text_en:
████-████ · Shift Log Four
M.1██.█.██

This position received three new lead type sets today. Standard inspection revealed minor alignment deviation in set two. Aberrant slugs removed per regulation and consigned to waste crucible.

This position notes tea stains from previous operator remain on left desk edge. This position does not consume tea.

Layer Five typesetting operations nominal. This position will continue assigned duties.

text_zh:
S-████ · 实验记录一
M.2██.█.██

实验编号: ME-047
对照组: 标准铅字钉 × 12
实验组: 经熔蜡浸润铅字钉 × 12
变量: 浸润时长（3分钟）

观察: 实验组铅字钉在铭刻过程中产生轻微发光现象。持续时间约0.7秒。对照组无此现象。
结论: 熔蜡处理确实产生可观测异常效应。建议延长浸润时间进行后续实验。
text_en:
S-████ · Experimental Log One
M.2██.█.██

Experiment ID: ME-047
Control Group: Standard lead slugs × 12
Test Group: Molten unguent-treated slugs × 12
Variable: Treatment duration (3 minutes)

Observation: Test group slugs exhibited mild luminescence during inscription. Duration approximately 0.7 seconds. Control group showed no such phenomenon.
Conclusion: Molten treatment does produce observable anomalous effects. Recommend extended treatment duration for subsequent trials.

text_zh:
S-████ · 实验记录二
M.2██.█.██

实验编号: ME-051
对照组: 第七层回收铅屑 × 30g
实验组: 第九层焊门处铅屑 × 30g（注：通过气动管获取）
变量: 铅屑来源层级

观察: 第九层铅屑在接触标准工具时产生异常共鸣。频率约为C调。对照组铅屑无声。实验者手指轻微刺痛感。
结论: 层级确实影响铅屑性质。第九层材料存在未知增益。实验成功。
text_en:
S-████ · Experimental Log Two
M.2██.█.██

Experiment ID: ME-051
Control Group: Layer Seven recycled shavings × 30g
Test Group: Layer Nine sealed-door shavings × 30g (Note: obtained via pneumatic tube)
Variable: Source layer of material

Observation: Layer Nine shavings produced anomalous resonance upon tool contact. Frequency approximately C-note. Control group shavings silent. Experimenter experienced mild finger tingling.
Conclusion: Layer depth does affect shaving properties. Layer Nine materials possess unknown enhancement. Experiment successful.
